## 1. Executive Summary

This document outlines recommended future directions grounded in the current state of the codebase, open issues, and emerging opportunities in the AI-assisted developer tooling space.

## 3. Immediate Priorities (0–1 Month)

These items are grounded directly in the currently open GitHub issues and represent hard prerequisites for any further feature expansion.

### 3.1 Fix LangGraph Fan-Out Concurrency Bug — BLOCKER 🔴

- **Issue:** [`#3 — LangGraph fan-out fails with InvalidUpdateError on parallel writes`](https://github.com/Bhavesh-0409/projectpilot/issues/3)
- **Root Cause Area:** Shared state management during parallel graph node execution; multiple agents writing to the same state channel simultaneously without conflict resolution.
- **Recommended Actions:**
  - Audit all fan-out graph nodes for unguarded shared-state writes.
  - Implement LangGraph reducer functions or channel-based state merging to serialize conflicting updates.
  - Add integration tests that specifically exercise parallel fan-out paths under concurrent load.
- **Risk if Unresolved:** Blocks all parallel and multi-agent feature expansion; the platform cannot safely scale its agentic capabilities with this bug present.

### 3.2 Unit Test Coverage for Scope Guard — ENHANCEMENT 🧪

- **Issue:** The scope guard component — a core safety and governance layer governing what actions the AI is permitted to take — currently lacks unit test coverage.
- **Recommended Actions:**
  - Write unit tests covering normal operation, boundary conditions, and adversarial/out-of-scope inputs.
  - Include regression tests for any past scope violations found during development.
  - Integrate tests into CI so that any future change to the scope guard is automatically validated.
- **Risk if Unresolved:** Untested safety components introduce silent regression risk; a broken scope guard could allow the AI to take unintended actions on user repositories.

## 4. Short-Term Roadmap (1–3 Months)

Building on a stabilised foundation after the immediate issues above are closed.

### 4.1 Expand the Auto-Documentation Suite

- **Current state:** Mermaid diagram generation is functional (evidenced by recent commits on July 28, 2026).
- **Future extensions:**
  - Auto-generate `CHANGELOG.md` entries from commit history and closed issues.
  - Auto-generate API reference stubs from code signatures detected in the repository.
  - Auto-generate architecture overview sections in `README.md` from inferred module structure.
- **Value:** Turns ProjectPilot AI into a full documentation co-pilot rather than a single-artifact generator.

### 4.2 Harden the Agentic Orchestration Layer

- **Current state:** LangGraph fan-out is the core orchestration mechanism.
- **Future work:**
  - Implement retry logic and graceful degradation for individual agent nodes so a single tool failure does not abort the entire workflow.
  - Add observability hooks (structured logging, tracing) at each LangGraph node boundary for debugging and performance profiling.
  - Introduce a workflow state persistence layer so long-running analyses can be resumed after interruption.

### 4.3 Scope Guard Formalisation

- **Current state:** Scope guard exists as a component but is undocumented and undertested.
- **Future work:**
  - Define a formal, declarative policy schema for what actions are in/out of scope.
  - Allow repository owners to configure scope policies via a config file (e.g., `.projectpilot.yaml`).
  - Emit structured audit logs whenever the scope guard blocks or modifies an AI action.

## 5. Medium-Term Roadmap (3–6 Months)

### 5.1 Multi-Repository Intelligence

- Enable cross-repository analysis so ProjectPilot AI can surface patterns, shared dependencies, or common issues across an organisation's entire GitHub account.
- Prerequisite: Stable single-repository orchestration (resolves blocker in §3.1 first).

### 5.2 Proactive Issue Triage and Labelling

- Extend the GitHub integration to automatically label new issues by severity and category using the AI analysis pipeline.
- Surface duplicate issue detection to reduce noise in the issue tracker.

### 5.3 Developer Dashboard

- Build a lightweight web UI that surfaces the health score, open blockers, recent artifact generation history, and roadmap gaps in a visual format.
- The health score infrastructure (currently at 81/100 for this repo) is already in place as a data foundation.

### 5.4 Plugin / Tool Extension API

- Expose a stable API for adding new tool nodes to the LangGraph workflow without modifying core orchestration code.
- This would allow community-contributed tools (e.g., security scanners, licence checkers) to integrate as first-class agents.
